tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: drag po me'i las mtha': spyi gshor nag po 'gyur med: rda thim:

ྈྈྈྈྈ shrī ya mān ta ka: drag po me yi las mtha' ni: phung gsum nag po'i nyi ma la: rab tu 'jigs pa'i dben gnas su: grib so sa la phebs pa'i tshe: khru gang gru gsum dong du bru: dug khrag ro sol dag gis byug: de steng gdug pa can gyi shing: dug dang tsher ma can gyis brtsig: gong ltar hoṃ khung dbyibs can la: dug dang tsher ma'i kha bad bya: dmigs bya'i rū pa che ba zhig: ling phran brgya rtsa lnga bcu 'am: nyi shu rtsa gcig 'di ltar bskor: yan lag gzugs bzhi brgyangs pa can: snying gar nṛ dang ming rus bri: yan lag mthil bzhir 'gugs pa'i sngags: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrnam bzhi bri: mtha' mar dmod mo las sngags bri: rdzas sna dgu byug dgug gzhug bya: btsan dug mi rta khyi gsum khrag: glang khrag zha nye mu zi nag: ro sol thang phrom dgu po dang: dmigs bya'i zag rdzas bsres pa rnams: ling ga'i grangs dang mnyam pa yi: gtor ma sha khrag brgyan pa yang: che ba bzhi dang bcas pa bsham: bsham dang bsngo ba zung du sprad: snod stong mi bzhag dam tshig yin: de nas gdug pa'i las la 'jug: rang bsrung rang bcas gang yod rnams: bdud rtsi chos sman byin brlabs rdzas: chang dang sbyar la khong du 'thung: bdag nyid ya mān ta ka'i sku: mthing nag mtshon cha'i ral pa can: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gsum bsgrad: dur khrod 'bar ba'i chas kyis brgyan: lag g.yon phreng ba nag po 'am: rag sha'i phreng ba gang 'dzom zhig: bzung la dgra bo dngos su dmigs: mtheb mo gser gyi s+t+wa re 'phyar: mdzub mo dngul gyi gtan pa'i khar: dgra bo'i mgo lus gtubs nas kyang: bsad bcad gtubs dmigs phreng ba yi: rdog ma re dang sprad nas kyang: phyir skyur 'og ltar dmigs pa sprad: phyag g.yas lcags kyu rnon po yis: dgra bgegs thams cad bkug par bsam: ral pa mtshon cha'i gur du phub: bdag nyid de ltar bsgoms nas kyang: mdun du hom las me sbar zhing: dug gi rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dbus:

me lha las kyi gshin rje'i gzugs: dmar nag gcer bu ral pa can: lte ba yan chad mtsho steng thon: lag gnyis nyi zla cha lang brdeb: kha ni rab tu gdangs dmigs la: sngags bzlas phreng ba phyir skyur bas: gnod byed mgo lus dum bu rnams: btang zhing zhal du gsol bar bsam: a+yai sa bh+yo zlog rbad: ces pa brgya rtsa bzlas nas kyang: rang gi mdun du stegs kyi khar: ling ga gtor ma sha khrag bsam: dgra bkug ling ga dag la thim: dgra bo dngos bsam me lhar 'bul: de tshe 'di ltar bsam rgyud du: dgra bo'i tshe dang bsod nams dang: 'khor dang longs spyod la sogs pa: kho yi dngos 'byor ma lus pa: las gshin zhal du bstims dmigs shing: lan bdun thim nas phrin las gzhol: dgra bo che ge mi nor dang bcas pa thams cad: las kyi gshin rje khyod la zas skal du gtad pa yin pas: 'di yi tshe srog dpal 'byor dbang thang dang bcas pa lhag ma med par bzhes shig: ces pa lan gsum brjod byas te: thal mo brdab cing bzhes sgra bsgrag: dgra bo gtan brlag gyur par dmigs: 'di yi las sbyor gtor ma 'bul: me sbar la sogs bya ba rnams: sha za las kyi mkha' 'gro 'am: gdong gcig kha ral shan pas bya: lan gsum lnga 'am bdun gyis ni: lo dus mi 'gyang dmigs bya 'gum: khyad par byad ma yin gyur na: kho yi lha dang srung ma rnams: rang gshed rang la dbab byas la: tha ma lha srung bcas pa rnams: mdun gyi las kyi gshin rje dang: bdag nyid gshin rje'i thugs kar bstim: des ni kho dang bral nas kyang: bdag nyid mthu dpung stongs grogs 'gyur: byad ma'i nus pa rang la ldog: ji ltar nus pa che na myur: gnod byed bgegs la byed na yang: ming bsgyur min pa gzhan rnams mthun: lan grangs brgya rtsa la sogs pa: thebs pa'i rjes la dmigs bya yi: rū pa che ba dum bur gtubs: sngags dang bcas te me lhar 'bul: lhag ma med par bzhes bsams la: las gshin mi dmigs rgya yis gdab:

sbyin sreg me ro ma lus pa: thal bar ma gyur bar du bsreg: thal bar gyur nas gtor chen dang: lhan cig dur khrod gnas su bskyal: yang na khri lam bzhi mdor 'phang: yang na 'gyu srang dong brus mnan: rnal 'byor bdud kyi chas su zhugs: gang 'tshogs kun kyang las sngags bzla: las zin rang nyid srung 'khor bsgom: yang na dmigs med rgya yis gdab: de ltar las mtha' zhag bdun nam: nyer gcig tha ma zhag gsum 'bad: ma grub spogs chog sbyar la bya: bgegs la gsum las mang mi 'tshal: dgra la bsod nams che chung sbyar: byad ma nus pa che na bzang: sngags bzlas mchil snabs phyir dor gnad: dmigs bya'i zag rdzas ma gtogs pa: rang gi zag rdzas ma 'dres gnad: shin tu gsang na las myur zhing: 'chal na mi 'grub spang ba gnad: gzhan yang bsreg rdzas sha khrag dang: drag po'i mthun rdzas sna tshogs 'bul: me la ro sol bro ba dang: dmigs pa gsal zhing rig pa 'ur: dngos nyams rmi lam la sogs la: las grub ltas 'byung spyi dang mthun: 'di ni las kyi gshin rje yi: bsad zlog me yi las mtha' ste: spyi gshor nag po 'gyur med yin: 'di la log rdugs 'byams mi srid: ma spel snying gi dkyil du chongs: sa ma ya: kha tham: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: gu h+ya dmar: so phag shi thaṃ: ya rog k+ṣa: las sbyor gyi mgo btsugs nas ma tshar gyi bar du smra ba bcad pa gal che: zhes spyi'i gdams pa yin par shes par bya'o: sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pas bya rgod gshongs nas bton pa'o/// /
